name: Riyadh
industries: Government programmes, sovereign-fund giga-projects, banking and telecom concentrate the Kingdom's project leadership demand in the capital.
intro:
Riyadh is the control room of Vision 2030. Ministries, PIF portfolio companies and delivery authorities in the capital direct the Kingdom's giga-projects, and they staff their PMOs with certified professionals as a matter of policy — PMP appears in Riyadh job descriptions more often than in any other Gulf city. Agile credentials are following quickly as government digital services scale. Live online batches run year-round with sensible Riyadh timings — a full Saturday–Sunday weekend cohort plus a midweek Wednesday–Thursday option — so you train during comfortable local daytime hours; the schedule table below lists every upcoming date with its exact Riyadh start and finish. Instruction is in English, the cohort is international, and invoices work for employer sponsorship, including programmes funding Saudi nationals’ development. We then guide the exam application, provide mock exams, and answer doubts until you pass.

Riyadh sits at the centre of the largest project pipeline on earth: Vision 2030 giga-projects, ministry digital programs and the corporate relocations driven by regional-headquarters rules have made certified project professionals one of the capital's most-recruited profiles. Delivery partners and consultancies bidding into these programs need certified staff on org charts, so the credential functions as a billability requirement, not just a CV line. Batches run live online with all times on this page shown for Riyadh, and the two-day weekend format fits Saudi work weeks without leave. Salary momentum in Riyadh is real but uneven — use the sourced figures below rather than anecdotes. The employer list shows who hires certified talent here, and giga-project suppliers can certify whole teams through private cohorts.

faq.q: What are the class timings in Riyadh?
faq.a: Live classes run 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM UK, which is 11:00 AM – 08:00 PM AST in Riyadh. You can pick a weekend (Sat–Sun) or a weekday (Wed–Thu) cohort; each completes the course over two consecutive days.

faq.q: Is the training online or at a venue in Riyadh?
faq.a: All batches are 100% live online, taught by an instructor over video with interactive exercises — there is no venue to travel to in Riyadh. You need a laptop, a stable connection and a free weekend.

faq.q: Is the certificate different if I attend from Saudi Arabia?
faq.a: No. The certification is issued by the same global body regardless of where you attend from, and holds identical recognition with employers in Saudi Arabia and internationally.

faq.q: Can my employer in Riyadh sponsor the course?
faq.a: Yes. We issue invoices suitable for corporate sponsorship and reimbursement, and most employers in Saudi Arabia accept them under learning and development budgets. Group pricing is available for teams.

faq.q: How much does {course} training cost in Riyadh?
faq.a: The fee for the live online {course} course for Riyadh is shown at the top of this page in SAR and covers the complete two-day program. The displayed amount is the complete training fee, with no hidden extras.

faq.q: Should I pick the weekday or weekend {course} batch in Riyadh?
faq.a: Identical {course} syllabus either way — choose whichever pair of days your Riyadh schedule can spare. The batch table above shows every session converted to Riyadh local time.

faq.q: Can I take the {course} exam from Riyadh?
faq.a: Yes — the {course} exam can be taken online from Riyadh; you do not need to travel. The exam and certification guide further up this page explains the exact format, attempts and booking process.

faq.q: Is {course} certification recognized by employers in Riyadh?
faq.a: Yes. The {course} credential is issued by its global certifying body and is the one most commonly named in relevant Riyadh job descriptions. The employer list on this page shows where certified professionals in Riyadh work.

faq.q: What salary can a {course}-certified professional expect in Riyadh?
faq.a: See the salary table on this page — every Riyadh figure carries a named source and an as-of date, so you can verify it rather than trust a marketing average. Certified professionals typically use these sourced numbers in appraisal and offer negotiations.

faq.q: How soon can I start {course} training in Riyadh?
faq.a: The batch table above lists the next start dates for Riyadh — two cohorts run every week (weekday and weekend), so you are never more than a few days from a {course} start.

faq.q: Do you offer group pricing for {course} training for teams in Riyadh?
faq.a: Yes. Teams in Riyadh can enroll together under group pricing, and larger groups can run a private {course} cohort scheduled to their own calendar — use the enquiry option on this page with your team size.

faq.q: What language is the {course} training in Riyadh delivered in?
faq.a: All live {course} sessions are delivered in English, the working language of certification exams and of most project teams in Riyadh. Trainers take questions throughout the live sessions.

faq.q: How do I enroll in the {course} course from Riyadh?
faq.a: Pick a batch from the table above and use its Enroll button — you'll get a confirmation by email. The full flow is online; nothing requires visiting an office in Riyadh.

faq.q: Where can I see the {course} exam fee for Saudi Arabia?
faq.a: The exam-cost section on this page lists the current {course} exam fee for Saudi Arabia with a link to the certifying body's official fee page, so the number you plan around is the official one.

faq.q: Why choose live online {course} training over a self-paced course in Riyadh?
faq.a: Live {course} classes include exercises, discussion and instant answers — the parts that make the material stick — and the two-day schedule means Riyadh learners are done, not perpetually 40% through a playlist.
